ZinComptime.Values: Types are first-class comptime values. comptime_int is arbitrary precision. comptime_float is compiler high precision.
ZinComptime.Generics: Generics use comptime parameters, anytype inference, and functions returning type. There is no separate template system.
ZinComptime.InlineFor: Every iteration is separately instantiated during semantic analysis. The iterable must be comptime-known.
ZinComptime.InlineWhile: The condition and progression must remain comptime evaluable.

Memory.Rule: CTFE allocations are not runtime heap allocations.
A comptime value used at runtime is materialized in static storage when representable.
A pointer to temporary comptime-only storage may not escape to runtime.

Effects.Forbidden: arbitrary OS syscalls, arbitrary network access, arbitrary process creation, nondeterministic host state
Effects.BuildScripts: build.zin executes through explicit std.Build host APIs and is not ordinary CTFE.

ZinComptime.Pruning: Branches whose conditions are comptime-known are eliminated before runtime lowering; non-selected branches must parse but need not generate runtime code.
